doc: Reviewed size and coupling budgets over the production tree: maximum lines per production file, maximum direct internal imports per package, maximum production files per command package, and the advisory staged-path bound per ordinary gate commit. Ceilings only tighten; a standing exceedance is a reviewed exception with its reason, retired by decomposition.

exceptions.subject: internal/cuda/executor/executor.go
exceptions.reason: The CUDA executor holds one dispatch table over every device operator; splitting it is a device-runtime decomposition, tracked separately from this budget.

exceptions.subject: internal/gate/commit.go
exceptions.reason: The two-phase Git commit transaction keeps intent, keepalive, index authority, reference exchange, and merge metadata in one phase file by design; further splitting risks a second transaction path.

exceptions.subject: internal/server
exceptions.reason: The server is the assembly root: it composes every workspace dependency explicitly, and the workspace-boundary audit holds each handler file to its declared couplings. Widened from 40 for the library lifecycle (gui-library): the model intake package the recipe command and the server both sequence.

exceptions.subject: cmd/recipe
exceptions.reason: cmd/recipe aggregates the recipe lifecycle subcommands; its per-task files are thin dispatchers over internal owners.
